Name: TV Shopping Network
Author: AirynS
Description:
Hey, viewers! Have we got an amazing deal for you!

Inspired by Harvest Moon, this mod adds a new TV channel, the TV Shopping Network. Simply watch the channel and you'll be able to buy that week's special offer - as long as you have the cash, of course! Each Saturday, one of a hundred various items or item bundles, including many rare, hard-to-get, or late-game items, will be available to purchase in a one-time offer, with your purchased item arriving by mail the next day. Offers include furniture, farm machinery, products, weapons, fishing tackle, clothing, and more! Make sure you have enough money though - items sell out fast and if you don't have enough gold on the spot, you'll miss your opportunity!

To help you figure out whether you want to save up for the upcoming special offer, once you've purchased your first item from the TV Shopping Network, you'll start receiving the TVSN weekly catalogue, which shows you three potential items that will be available for sale on the coming Saturday. Only one will actually be available though, so make sure you've got enough!

Be careful though - there's always a slight risk of damage in transit and you might find that your beloved purchase arrives in not-so-good condition. If this happens, you can embark on a short quest to receive a refund as long as you're fast enough. Ferngill Republic consumer law (mumble mutter mumble) means you have to return the item within three days or you're no longer entitled to a refund! If you're not the risk-taking type though, simply contact our services about our "Realism Mode" configuration option and you can rest in peace knowing that your item will arrive exactly as you imagine it.

[size=5][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]First ensure that all required framework mods are installed, then simply extract the "TV Shopping Network" folder from the zip and drop it into your Mods folder.[/color]

[size=5][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]
TV Shopping Network requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41844?]BroadcastAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296]Esca's Modding Plugins[/url].

This is a companion mod to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46331]Harvest Moon TV Variety Channel[/url] and is recommended to be used alongside it!

[size=5][b]CONFIGURATION
[/b][/size]TV Shopping Network has one config option, "Realism Mode". When set to "true", there will be a small chance of receiving a junk item instead of your purchased item, with an accompanying special order to get a refund. If you prefer not to have this feature, set "Realism Mode" to "false".

[b][size=5]TRANSLATIONS[/size][/b]
Translations are welcome as long as only the translated i18n file is uploaded and no AI is used in the process of translating.

[b][size=5]THANKS[/size][/b]
Thanks to my friends, especially in the SMC server, for encouraging my scope-creep and prompting several of the [s]more realisticmore annoying[/s] sillier features of this mod!
